scope: Exact fixed analysis regions for the three reported ten-scan series in main Table 5.

definition_provenance.specified_by: a member of the study team
definition_provenance.method: Polygons drawn by hand on the first-scan scanner texture with annotate_roi.py, which displays the texture only. No depth, variance or validity information was shown while drawing. Include polygons are united and exclude polygons (holes) are subtracted.
definition_provenance.criterion: Each region covers the visible outline of the tissue plus the visible parts of the instruments in the field of view; the holes in the instrument handle are excluded.

history.by: a member of the study team
history.note: The eye region was redrawn once, before any result was computed.

coordinates.display: zero-based (x,y), x rightward and y downward, width 1544, height 2064
coordinates.normalization: integer x = Python round(u*(width-1)); integer y = Python round(v*(height-1)); exact integer vertices also supplied
coordinates.rasterization: Pillow ImageDraw.polygon on an L image filled with 255, then >0, for every polygon, no antialiasing. Region = union of the include polygons minus the union of the exclude polygons.
coordinates.orientation: The texture display is rotated 90 degrees clockwise relative to native arrays. Rotate the display mask 90 degrees counterclockwise using numpy.rot90(k=1) to obtain native shape (1544,2064).
coordinates.normative: Stored native Boolean masks are the exact analysis definitions; vertices and code reproduce them bit for bit.

support_rule: C = R AND V1 AND ... AND V10. Vi requires finite original XYZ, native Z > 0, finite depth and depth > 0. NR=count(R), NC=count(C), coverage=NC/NR. Regional grid size is distinct from common-valid support.
